report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes of the authorized window (2026-09-28T13:07:56Z to 13:12:56Z) checkout was observed failing, and the failure observed in the returned traces is localized to the checkout-to-payment charge call. Checkout error-status spans are present (traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=checkout,status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR} increase 2.6511845932049436, made up of oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 1.3255922966024718 and the checkout-emitted oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client span 1.3255922966024718), and the payment service itself shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR 1.3255922966024718. Six error traces were returned by the checkout trace search: 1cd2addeae73f21af3f55ddbf0f68ccf, 40cb2b714e0c3a8a84c493c95871a97f, c4142662533cf8eeca42b34454b40d08, 60ad1724f3d1adfac6b1cbad241ca699, 4c12c222407bc64f5ea9a73fcf9af16f and e9a120ef3f8133892674abd3ef6e37ac. In each, checkout PlaceOrder returns otel.status_code ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and description 'failed to charge card: ... Payment request failed. Invalid token', the payment Charge span in the same trace carries grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and the failure surfaces as HTTP 500 at frontend POST /api/checkout, frontend-proxy ingress and load-generator POST. In the immediately preceding comparable 5-minute window (13:00:00Z-13:05:00Z) payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR was explicitly 0 and every checkout gRPC client call had rpc_grpc_status_code 0, so the errors are new in the final 5 minutes rather than sustained. No error-status spans were observed for cart, currency, shipping or product-catalog. Latency: checkout's own server p95 is essentially unchanged across the two comparable windows (240.00000000000003 ms baseline vs 242.5 ms target), while product-catalog server p95 rose from 8.37499999999998 ms to 3400.0000000000005 ms via a new 2500-5000 ms tail (6.334138365279 new calls above the 2500 ms bucket out of 81.0769724507204) that no visible span in the delivered samples corroborates. Unresolved: email could not be assessed, no server-duration series exist for payment/cart/currency/shipping, the trace views are truncated/incomplete samples, and the root cause of the invalid-token rejection is not evidenced.
